# Revvin

> Revvin (revvin.co) is a free referral program and local referral network for home-service businesses.

Revvin is operated by Nationwide Sales Group Inc.

Last updated: 2026-11-27

Revvin gives a home-service business a referral page on its own link, a personal link for every person who refers, and an ask after every job. The business pays a reward only when a referral turns into a job, and pays it directly. Revvin is not affiliated with the Revvin digital mortgage platform.

## Free

Free, forever, no card:

- A published referral page on your own link, with unlimited referrals.
- A personal link for every customer, so each referral is credited automatically.
- QR code and print-ready kit with PDF downloads and "email my kit to a print shop".
- Lead inbox and referral alerts, and reward tracking.
- Bring up to 500 customers: upload, paste, or send us your list.
- One launch campaign: Revvin emails every customer their own referral link from your business name, with two follow-ups.
- Ask customers one at a time from your own phone or email any time.
- An Earn listing where Earn is live, so locals can find you and get their own link.

## Pro

- Revvin Pro is $97/month USD, or $970/year USD billed once.
- Adds unlimited customers, unlimited launch campaigns to your whole list, an automatic review and referral ask after every job (Job done, or through job software, API or Zapier), win-back email campaigns, ROI reporting and monthly recap, and custom page branding.
- Pro is free for 14 days, starting when you send your first campaign. No card. Yearly billing gives two months free.
- Cancel anytime; the referral page stays live.

## Optional done-for-you launch

$297 one-time: we load your customer list, set up your page and reward with you, and send the first asks with you. If no referral arrives within 60 days of your first asks, we refund the $297 in full, provided you asked at least 50 customers and email info@revvin.co within 90 days of purchase. Refunds are issued manually.

## What Revvin does not do

- Revvin does not pay referrers, hold funds or take a cut of rewards. Businesses pay their referrers directly, off-platform.
- Revvin never sends SMS to a business's customers. Personal asks open on the owner's own device; launch and win-back campaigns are emails Revvin sends from the business name, with an unsubscribe link.
- Revvin takes nothing from referral rewards.

## Earn, for referrers

- Locals earn a reward, paid directly by the business, when a referral turns into a job.
- Earn opens city by city across the US and Canada.
- Free for referrers. No earnings are promised.

## Team

- Revvin is built by a team serving home-service businesses across the US and Canada.

- [Privacy](/privacy): Data handling and advertising measurement by Meta, OpenAI (ChatGPT Ads) and Google (Google Ads). The Google tag file itself loads on every page with measurement switched off by default, so Google receives a standard file request, including network IP address and browser request information, even where measurement is off; page views, click identifiers and the account-creation event are sent only when advertising measurement is allowed. Eligible account-creation events include the selected trade, but no contact details or enhanced conversions. Google receives a welcome page view only after new account creation, not later setup visits. The same advertising opt-out and regional exclusions cover Google. When permitted, OpenAI measures qualified home-service signup completion and uses its own __oppref (30 days) and __obref (365 days) first-party cookies. OpenAI's Pixel may also detect email and phone typed into signup forms, hash them with SHA-256 in the browser and send only the hash for ad matching; raw values are not sent. Opting out stops measurement and this matching and removes the cookies.
